name: 28a71ee4-32c6-4f4f-9342-54dcd99cdabf
description: Washington Gas voice and chat agent for billing, payments, hardship, service, appointments, account support and outages.

variableDeclarations.name: _action_trigger
variableDeclarations.description: Internal trigger for deterministic callback actions: emergency, live_agent_handoff, replay_consent or return_to_origin.

variableDeclarations.name: _office_notice
variableDeclarations.description: Internal: given once the after-hours notice and callback form were shown, so they are never repeated in the same conversation.

variableDeclarations.name: _emergency_card_shown
variableDeclarations.description: Internal: true once the chat emergency card was shown, so it is never repeated in the same conversation.

variableDeclarations.name: _escalation_reason
variableDeclarations.description: Internal handoff reason code such as no_input_escalation or auth_failure_handoff.

variableDeclarations.name: _escalation_topic
variableDeclarations.description: Internal handoff queue: billing, service, collections, medical, bereavement, regulatory or emergency.

variableDeclarations.name: _return_to_agent
variableDeclarations.description: Internal agent to return to after authentication succeeds.

variableDeclarations.name: _verbatim_pending
variableDeclarations.description: Internal key of the verbatim string the callback must speak exactly.

variableDeclarations.name: _welcome_line
variableDeclarations.description: Internal: the personal line spoken once after a chat customer is identified and verified; set by the callback, spoken with the next reply, then cleared.

variableDeclarations.name: _welcome_line_mode
variableDeclarations.description: Internal: prefix (join the line to the next reply), alone (the line is the whole reply) or done (already spoken, never again).

variableDeclarations.name: account_ctx
variableDeclarations.description: Balance and bill state, set only from successful tool results; a default of zero means not loaded.

variableDeclarations.name: ani
variableDeclarations.description: Caller phone number normalized to E.164 (+1XXXXXXXXXX); PII, shown only as last 4 digits.

variableDeclarations.name: api_failed
variableDeclarations.description: true after a transient or system tool error; drives retry once then system_unavailable.

variableDeclarations.name: appointment_ctx
variableDeclarations.description: The active appointment being discussed.

variableDeclarations.name: auth_attempts_tier1
variableDeclarations.description: Failed identification attempts with the current method; escalate at 3.

variableDeclarations.name: auth_attempts_tier2
variableDeclarations.description: Failed verification attempts across all methods; escalate at 3.

variableDeclarations.name: auth_method_tier1
variableDeclarations.description: How the account was identified: ANI, JWT, MobileNum, NameAddress or AccountNum.

variableDeclarations.name: auth_method_tier2
variableDeclarations.description: How the caller was verified: SSN, TaxID, PIN, CCLast4 or JWTAuth.

variableDeclarations.name: auth_status
variableDeclarations.description: Guest, Identified or Authenticated; set only from authentication tool results.

variableDeclarations.name: cc_on_file
variableDeclarations.description: true when a card is on file; the card option is offered only then.

variableDeclarations.name: channel
variableDeclarations.description: Channel of the session, voice or chat, derived from the predefined _session variable.

variableDeclarations.name: degraded_mode
variableDeclarations.description: true when the account system is down or slow; transactions are blocked.

variableDeclarations.name: demo_ctx
variableDeclarations.description: Demo controls: failure injection mode and the demo clock override; injected whole by evals.

variableDeclarations.name: dtmf_digits
variableDeclarations.description: Keypad digits for the current turn only; cleared on the next turn, never echoed or logged.

variableDeclarations.name: emergency_detected
variableDeclarations.description: true once a gas emergency was detected; set before any other logic of the turn.

variableDeclarations.name: global_err_count
variableDeclarations.description: Tool errors accumulated across modules; the third ends in a handoff.

variableDeclarations.name: hardship_ctx
variableDeclarations.description: Hardship checkpoints that prove the Arrearage Management Program was offered first and that disclosures were spoken before enrollment.

variableDeclarations.name: identification_status
variableDeclarations.description: Result of identification, Pass or Fail.

variableDeclarations.name: identity_ctx
variableDeclarations.description: Who the caller is; written by the identification tools. account_number_last4 is the only account number ever spoken.

variableDeclarations.name: insight_memory
variableDeclarations.description: Internal: JSON text with what get_account_insights showed, the customer declined or accepted, the number of proactive offers and whether further offers are closed after a no. Written only by get_account_insights; never read aloud.

variableDeclarations.name: language
variableDeclarations.description: Current conversation language, EN or ES; follows the caller turn by turn.

variableDeclarations.name: local_noinput_counter
variableDeclarations.description: Consecutive silences in the current module; the third ends in a handoff.

variableDeclarations.name: outage_active
variableDeclarations.description: true when an outage is recorded for the caller's ZIP code.

variableDeclarations.name: pa_downpayment_status
variableDeclarations.description: pending, paid or failed for a payment arrangement down payment.

variableDeclarations.name: page_context
variableDeclarations.description: Website page the chat visitor opened the assistant from: home, billing, service, safety, assistance, savings, business, choice, claims, energy, spanish or contact; empty when unknown or on voice. Set by the website through the widget variables, never asked of the caller.

variableDeclarations.name: payment_ctx
variableDeclarations.description: Payment choice and flags, and the payment arrangement down payment; written by the payment and arrangement tools.

variableDeclarations.name: payment_decline_count
variableDeclarations.description: Consecutive payment declines; the third forces a live agent handoff.

variableDeclarations.name: pin_entry_open
variableDeclarations.description: Rev 24: true while a verified caller is entering a new portal PIN (set by reset_portal_pin; opens keypad capture on voice).

variableDeclarations.name: pin_reset_done
variableDeclarations.description: Rev 24: true after reset_portal_pin changed the PIN in this session.

variableDeclarations.name: pin_reset_failures
variableDeclarations.description: Rev 24: number of rejected new-PIN entries in this session; three end the in-call reset.

variableDeclarations.name: pin_set
variableDeclarations.description: true when a portal PIN is set; the PIN option is offered only then.

variableDeclarations.name: route
variableDeclarations.description: Internal module label M1 to M9 for the current topic; never spoken.

variableDeclarations.name: saved_task_state
variableDeclarations.description: Task saved for a topic switch or the authentication round trip so the specialist can resume without re-asking.

variableDeclarations.name: sentiment_score
variableDeclarations.description: Caller distress from 0.0 calm to 1.0 distressed; 0.6 empathy mode, 0.8 empathy protocol.

variableDeclarations.name: service_ctx
variableDeclarations.description: Service order state; addresses are standardized before submission.

variableDeclarations.name: ssn_tax_flag
variableDeclarations.description: SSN or TAXID from get_auth_options; decides which last-4 question applies.

variableDeclarations.name: telephony-caller-id
variableDeclarations.description: Caller phone number supplied by the Google Telephony Platform; empty on chat. Bridged to telephony_caller_id by before_agent.

variableDeclarations.name: telephony_caller_id
variableDeclarations.description: Plain copy of the platform variable telephony-caller-id, bridged by before_agent.

variableDeclarations.name: tenant_ctx
variableDeclarations.description: Brand and configuration summary loaded by get_tenant_config.

variableDeclarations.name: tenant_id
variableDeclarations.description: Tenant of this app; the Washington Gas app defaults to WGL. Never asked of the caller.

variableDeclarations.name: ui_language
variableDeclarations.description: Language the website visitor picked with the English or Spanish toggle on the page welcome: en or es; empty when unknown or on voice. Set by the website through the widget variables, never asked of the caller. before_agent copies es or en into language on the first turn.

variableDeclarations.name: utterance
variableDeclarations.description: Latest caller text; keypad entries are stored as the word keypad entry, never as digits.
